label: en-NG-01
script: Please send ten thousand naira to Tunde Bello from my savings account before noon today.

script: Good morning, I want to check the balance on my current account and see the last three transactions.

script: I did not authorise the charge of two thousand five hundred naira on my card yesterday. Please open a dispute for it.

label: en-NG-04
script: Kindly transfer fifty thousand naira to Amaka Eze for the school fees and send me a confirmation message.

label: en-NG-05
script: What is the status of the complaint I raised last week about the failed airtime purchase?

label: en-NG-06
script: I need to change the daily limit on my transfers from one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand naira.

label: pcm-01
script: Abeg, I wan send ten thousand naira give Tunde, make you do am before afternoon.

label: pcm-05
script: Wetin happen to the complain wey I put last week about the airtime wey no enter?

label: pcm-06
